title: Atomic, covalent and ionic radii
basic_overview: Ionic size is strongly controlled by electron count and nuclear charge; covalent radius depends on bonding.

extra_info_content.short_trick: Isoelectronic series: more protons → smaller radius.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Count electrons. 2. If isoelectronic, compare Z. 3. Account for shell loss/gain. 4. For covalent radius compare bonded atoms.
extra_info_content.factors: Ionic radius depends on coordination environment.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
